summary: Tested the two new phases (Gelişmiş RSVP + Davetiye Editörü). Found and fixed 1 compile-blocking bug in InvitationView.jsx (useEffect declared after early returns violating Rules of Hooks — see rca). After the fix, ALL flows pass: (1) Guest RSVP: reveal-open-btn opens invitation, rsvp-count=3 spawns rsvp-companion-0/1 rows with name+menu selects, rsvp-menu options are Standart/Vejetaryen/Çocuk, transfer checkbox present; submitting name+surname+menu=Vejetaryen+companions+guest_count=3 → 'Yanıtınız alındı, teşekkürler!' toast and card shows 'Yanıtınız kaydedildi'. Font override 'Dancing Script' loads and applies to couple-name h1 (computed fontFamily = '"Dancing Script", serif'). (2) Owner RSVP report: registered a new member via /api/member/register (needs kvkk_accepted+sms_consent+email_consent all true), created invitation ali-ayse-8e87b5 with font_family/name_scale, posted 2 RSVPs (one Vejetaryen+Transfer+2 companions Çocuk/Standart, one Standart). Logged into /davetiyelerim, opened inv-report, report-menu-summary shows: Standart 2, Vejetaryen 1, Çocuk 1, Transfer 1. RSVP row shows Vejetaryen + Transfer badges + '+ Ayse C, Mehmet C' companions. CSV endpoint returns exact required columns: 'Ad,Soyad,Katılım,Kişi Sayısı,Menü,Transfer,Refakatçiler,Not,Tarih' with correct rows. (3) Wizard /davetiye-olustur: inv-font-family select has 10 fonts (Great Vibes, Dancing Script, Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Sacramento, Parisienne, Pinyon Script, Allura, Tangerine, Marcellus). inv-name-scale has Küçük/Orta/Büyük/Çok Büyük (0.85/1/1.2/1.4). Selecting Dancing Script + 1.2 updates preview couple-names to fontFamily 'Dancing Script' at 105.6px (visibly larger). (4) Design Studio /tasarim-studyosu: ds-add-symbol opens ds-symbol-dialog with 60 buttons across all 6 categories (Kalpler, Çiçek & Yaprak, Düğün & Yüzük, Yıldız & Işıltı, Geometrik & Çerçeve, Kına & Geleneksel). Clicking a symbol (ds-symbol-Kalpler-0) inserts a heart node on the canvas and closes the dialog. ds-save-btn is present and, when not logged in as member, correctly redirects to member login (expected per spec). Autosave indicator was not observed because it only appears when logged in — noted as expected.
action_items: None functional. Consider adding an ESLint rule (react-hooks/rules-of-hooks was already the reporter) — E1 should not put useEffect after an early return; the previous iteration had the same class of bug in AdminAnnouncements. A quick lint gate in CI would catch these before serve time.
critical_code_review_comments: InvitationView.jsx: useEffect for loadGoogleFont(inv?.font_family) was placed AFTER the `if (loading) return ...; if (error) return ...;` early returns AND after `const t = getTheme(...)` — violates Rules of Hooks (conditional hook order). Fixed by moving the useEffect above the early returns.

MyInvitations.jsx uses /api/member/login which restricts to role=member. The admin@fotuber.com.tr user has role=admin, so the request note that 'admin owns test invitations at /davetiyelerim' is misleading — admin CANNOT log into /davetiyelerim with those creds (returns 401 'E-posta veya şifre hatalı'). If admin is meant to access owned invitations, either whitelist admin role in /api/member/login or add a separate admin invitation panel. Not a functional bug for members, but E1 should decide.

rca of the issue: Bug: /davetiye/font-test-b5a017 (and the whole app) served a 'Compiled with problems' overlay because src/pages/InvitationView.jsx line 113 called useEffect AFTER `if (loading) return ...; if (error) return ...;`. On the first render (loading=true) the effect is never registered; on subsequent renders it is — React's hook-order invariant breaks and CRA/eslint (react-hooks/rules-of-hooks) blocks the build. Fix: moved the `useEffect(() => { loadGoogleFont(inv?.font_family) })` block above the early returns (kept the `if (inv.font_family)` style override where it was). After hot reload, the page mounted cleanly, font_family/name_scale were applied to the couple names, and the full RSVP submission succeeded.
